datasets.attribution: MBPP (Mostly Basic Python Problems), Google Research — https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/mbpp
datasets.derivation: mbpp.jsonl task IDs 11–510 (the paper's test split, 500 problems). initial_state = prompt + signature derived from the reference solution's def line + test_setup_code; expected_outcome.tests = test_list (3 hidden tests every problem carries); the reference solution itself is never vendored.

datasets.attribution: DROP (Discrete Reasoning Over Paragraphs), Allen Institute for AI — https://allennlp.org/drop. Vendored slice distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0; it carries the upstream share-alike terms.
datasets.derivation: drop_dataset_dev.json, stratified by answer type (date > number > span, since DROP answers are multi-type) with proportional largest-remainder allocation and a fixed sample seed (20261126). expected_outcome carries gold surfaces plus validated_answers (ADR-0005 takes the max over both).

datasets.attribution: ExtractBench, LlamaIndex — https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/ExtractBench (Apache-2.0); source documents are public records.
datasets.derivation: short, then medium, then long split documents in id order, mined for exact-match fields: leaves of expected_output whose field_rule comparator is a string comparison (exact / case_insensitive / enum / name / address / phone), record lists excluded. A document is adopted when at least 3 such golden values survive PDF text extraction (punctuation/whitespace-insensitive check); only those answerable fields are kept as keys. document = normalized PDF text (unpdf).

Five document templates (invoice, purchase order, lab report, lease summary, support ticket) × 30 seeded variants. Golden values are rendered verbatim into each document; the generator is deterministic (mulberry32, seed 20261126).

source.revision: scripts/seeds/synthetic-extraction.ts @ repo HEAD of the freeze commit

datasets.attribution: SWE-bench Lite, Princeton NLP / SWE-bench team — https://www.swebench.com/lite (MIT).
datasets.derivation: All 300 Lite instances in id order. initial_state = official per-instance eval image tags (x86_64 + arm64) + repo + base_commit + problem_statement; expected_outcome = test_patch + FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS. Repo snapshots are not vendored: the image is the snapshot (ADR-0007). The gold `patch` is deliberately not vendored.

datasets.attribution: SWE-bench Lite subset — same attribution and licenses as the full vendored set.
datasets.derivation: The 50-instance first-report subset: every 6th instance of the 300 in id order (systematic sample), so all 11 Lite repos stay represented. Instance envelope otherwise identical to the full set.

agentic_images.note: Image tags are pinned but digests are not: 0/300 instances resolved a digest. Re-run `bun run datasets:fetch --pin-digests` with a reachable registry (`SWEBENCH_REGISTRY`) to fill them.
